summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that the Allen-Gallagher prize fight would take place near St. Louis on November 1. The last stakes were put up at Allen's saloon, and Allen had stopped training on a false report that Gallagher was sick.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Tuesday Morning, Oct. 25, 1870'. This is before the 1875 Globe-Democrat merger.

facts.fact: The last instalment of the battle money for the Allen-Gallagher fight was put up at Allen's saloon, with Allen the 2-to-1 favorite. The fight was set for November 1 near St. Louis
Allen stopped training and was 'rather full in flesh' after hearing that Gallagher was sick with intermittent fever, a report later contradicted

notes: This is the same event as article 422 (the Missouri Republican, same date).
